detector.participation: adjusted current completed-bar share volume / mean(adjusted share volume of exactly prior 20 comparable completed bars); current excluded; missing comparable history unavailable

detector.rearm: only after prior episode terminates and new qualifying formation/range is frozen

detector.weekly_context: directional log return over prior 13 completed Weekly bars

evaluation.calendar_block_rule: Ordered unique NYSE sessions; circular contiguous blocks. Duplicate sampled dates repeat full cross-sectional date block.
evaluation.embargo_rule: 22 strict NYSE sessions between training-origin cutoff and calibration start, and 22 strict sessions between calibration end and each outer test start; derived from trigger -> next lawful P0 reference -> common 21-session terminal.
evaluation.episode_cluster_rule: Primary 22-session date block spans longest R0 primary label horizon and activation episodes <=10-bar; report episode counts and never treat landmark rows as independent n. 44/66 fixed sensitivities cannot replace primary.
evaluation.familywise_control_exact_method: Holm step-down FWER alpha=0.05 across exactly 8 primary claim p-values; blocked/unrun/invalid p=1. Q1 claim p=max of three one-sided IUT component p-values.

inference_method.primary: 22-session circular moving calendar-block bootstrap, 5000 draws, seed 20261006, all same-date cross-section moves together

fakeout.rule: completed close back inside original frozen range within three recipe bars after trigger, before favorable primary barrier

labels.missing_halt_delist_immature: typed separate outcomes, never silently imputed

models.calibration: Separate 126-session chronological slice. Binary Platt slope+intercept; multinomial common positive log-odds slope + K-1 intercept shifts. Unpenalized; require class support, convergence and slope>0. Primary outer-test loss is calibrated; unavailable calibration blocks fold/claim.
models.zero_variance_policy: train SD<=1e-12 => standardized column fixed at zero for train/calibration/test and recorded; no post-test deletion choice

population.floor_suspect_exclusion_rule: Exclude an entire ticker key from R0 when an overlapping membership interval begins exactly on a known index reconstruction floor and the first observed vendor date is later than max(R2 start, interval start). Do not substitute first price for membership/listing start.
population.identity_claim: Observable vendor-ticker spell only, not issuer/security continuity. Exact dot-to-dash vendor normalization is permitted; ambiguous/unresolved keys yield zero spells. Current aliases are never backdated.
population.observational_unit: membership-bounded vendor-ticker spell = maximal run of observed Daily rows on every expected NYSE session inside one continuous UNION-S&P1500 membership episode. Missing expected source session or a real S&P1500 non-membership hiatus terminates the spell. A continuous S&P600->S&P400->S&P500 promotion does not reset the spell.
